title: Constant-scalar direct image preserves local completeness
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$ be small sites, $A$ a commutative ring, $L\dashv V$ an adjunction of their topoi with $L$ preserving finite limits, and $F$ its algebraic inverse-image datum [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Suppose $P=\mathrm{pull}(F,\mathrm{constantMap}(F,A))$ is exact and has an additive right adjoint $G$. Let $RG$ with comparison $\eta$ be the universal total right derived functor on the unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], computed on K-injective representatives [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For $a\in A$, let $\beta_a$ be its transported global target section from [lem-sp-constant-inverse-image-section]. Suppose for $N\in D(\mathcal E,\underline A)$ that the localized derived internal Hom from $\underline A|_U[1/\beta_a|_U]$ to $N|_U$ vanishes for every $U\in\mathcal E$. Then for every $W\in\mathcal C$ the localized derived internal Hom from $\underline A|_W[1/a]$ to $(RG(N))|_W$ vanishes, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element]. No ideal or Noetherian hypothesis is used.

proof.text: The local Hom tower criterion, using the proved completeElement_iff_towerIso helper from Sheaf.Paper.RestrictionSectionCompleteness, identifies each slice test with invertibility of its Roos endomorphism. Countable derived products exist by the termwise K-injective product theorem. Exact slice restriction has an exact left adjoint, hence its derived restriction preserves products. All slice restrictions jointly reflect module isomorphisms by evaluation at slice terminal objects, and their exact derived functors jointly reflect isomorphisms by cohomology. Comparing product shifts identifies all local tests with invertibility of the global multiplication-tower Roos endomorphism.

Apply [lem-sp-exact-pullback-derived-adjunction] and uniqueness of total right derived functors to make RF a right adjoint. Thus it preserves products and is additive. The ordinary transported-scalar square [lem-sp-constant-pullback-scalar] transposes through the module counit to the square carrying multiplication by beta_a through G to multiplication by a. Naturality of ηG on a K-injective representative, conjugated by its computation isomorphism, gives the same scalar square for RF.

Apply RF to the invertible global Roos endomorphism. Its product comparison conjugates this map to the global scalar Roos endomorphism on RF(N), because RF preserves subtraction and the scalar transitions. The global/local criterion gives every target slice test.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099J/0997 and 0A07; use product comparisons and joint slice conservativity directly, avoiding strict tower-image and strict-limit comparison lemmas.

theorem constantScalarDirectImage_complete
    {C E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory E]
    (JC : GrothendieckTopology C) (JD : GrothendieckTopology E)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)}
    (V : Sheaf JD (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (F : InverseImageData L)
    (G : Mod (constant JD A) ⥤+ Mod (constant JC A))
    (aM : pull F (constantMap F A) ⊣ G.obj)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (pull F (constantMap F A))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (pull F (constantMap F A))]
    (RF : D (constant JD A) ⥤ D (constant JC A))
    (ηG : G.obj.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ Q (constant JC A) ⟶
      Q (constant JD A) ⋙ RF)
    (hRF : RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor ηG
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (Mod (constant JD A)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hηG : ∀ J : Cx (constant JD A), J.IsKInjective → IsIso (ηG.app J))
    (a : A) (N : D (constant JD A))
    (hN : ∀ U : E, @IsRingedSiteCompleteElement E _ JD (constant JD A)
      (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (fun _ ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard _) N U
      ((transportedConstantSection F A a).val (op U))) :
    ∀ U : C, @IsRingedSiteCompleteElement C _ JC (constant JC A)
      (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (fun _ ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (RF.obj N) U
      ((constantSection (J := JC) a).val (op U))
